target.title: fix(discord): send fresh final messages after previews
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Discord partial streaming finalized an answer by editing the existing preview message. If the user left the channel during a long turn, that `MESSAGE_UPDATE` did not reliably advance Discord's unread/channel highlight, so a completed answer could arrive unnoticed.

Fixes #99662.

## Why This Change Was Made

The durable final now uses the normal send path, producing a fresh message after preview cleanup. This matches Discord's separate [Create Message](https://docs.discord.com/developers/resources/message#create-message) and [Gateway message event](https://docs.discord.com/developers/events/gateway-events#message-create) contracts and removes the second in-place finalization path.

Fresh bot messages normally parse broadcast mentions, unlike the old edit path. The maintained version therefore carries an explicit `allowed_mentions` policy through text, media, chunked, and forum delivery: targeted user and role pings remain enabled, while `@everyone` and `@here` cannot escalate.

## User Impact

- Completed streamed Discord answers arrive as a new message and can restore the normal unread/channel cue.
- The preview is cleared only after the fresh final succeeds; a failed send retains the visible preview.
- Targeted user/role mentions continue to work without enabling broadcast pings.
- Media, TTS, error, chunking, reply, forum, and progress-summary routes keep their existing delivery behavior.

## Evidence

- Exact prepared head: `0041b7ffa47e128242fc2f3bc2a55b4eb30985b1`.
- Hosted exact-head CI: [run 28811114011](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28811114011), including production/test typechecks, lint, build, guards, QA smoke, and relevant compact shards.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kww6wp8mafqazb1d425qyf36`: 183 focused Discord tests passed; `pnpm check:changed` passed extension production/test typechecks, full extension lint, and repository guards.
- Sanitized AWS Crabbox `run_ade515667559`: the exact pushed fork head passed the same 183 focused tests with public networking, no Tailscale, no instance role, and no hydrated credentials.
- Live Discord sandbox on the exact pushed head: preview and final had distinct increasing message IDs; both messages were readable; literal `@everyone` produced `mention_everyone=false`; both test messages deleted successfully with HTTP 204.
- Fresh autoreview after the runtime-enum repair: no accepted/actionable findings, confidence 0.96.

## Implementation Notes

- Declares Discord in-place `finalEdit` support disabled while retaining normal fallback and preview cleanup.
- Deletes the duplicate final-edit/chunking branches and delegates lifecycle ordering to the shared finalizable-preview helper.
- Adds focused regression coverage for fresh finals, mention safety, TTS/media/error fallback, and failed-send preview retention.
